observed_issue.summary: One first-boot receiver crash occurred before credential-encrypted storage was available to the user.
observed_issue.fix_status_as_of_2026_11_17: Source patch and an unsigned review candidate prepared and statically reviewed; not integrated or device tested.
observed_issue.scope: This single early-boot event does not establish that Dolby is wholly broken.

test_boundary: This verifies Android userspace booted and setup completed in DSU over the host's existing kernel and Magisk-patched vendor_boot.
It does not verify a full OTA boot using the candidate's clean vendor_boot, a new vbmeta root, or another device.
The candidate is not ready for general flashing.
